behavior: Calling any of java_hover, java_definition or java_references against a workspace that is still warming up (not yet index-ready) always produces a structured error explicitly naming the not-ready case -- never a successful result, and never a successful empty result standing in for 'still starting up'.
rationale: Requires a real workspace mid-warm-up and a real readiness-gate decision -- same integration/e2e_scenario reasoning TP-READY-0001 uses for the sibling not-ready case; this feature's falsifier names the not-ready sweep case, distinct from feat-tool-layer-core's own unit-level condition against a fake facade [INV-TOOL-4]. Falsifies a not-ready workspace reported as an empty success instead of a named error.
